name: Clinical Medicine
boundaries: Clinical Medicine: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Safe, systemic reversal of biological aging in adult humans
original_dispositions.reason: The entry limits claims to multi-tissue functional rejuvenation with a cancer-safety requirement, and does not treat one-organ trial clearance as success.

original_dispositions.original_title: Root-cause cure for Alzheimer’s disease and other neurodegenerative disorders
original_dispositions.reason: Alzheimer’s disease, with arrest and recovery after symptoms, is covered. A unified cure of Parkinson’s disease, frontotemporal dementia, and other neurodegenerative disorders was not added because those diseases do not share one demonstrated causal lever.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal, durable functional cure for HIV and other persistent viral infections
original_dispositions.reason: The retained entry is stricter than functional cure: rebound-competent HIV and hepatitis B cccDNA have to be gone. Herpesvirus latency remains a possible later application.

original_dispositions.original_title: Scarless, functional regeneration of complex human tissues and organs in adults
original_dispositions.reason: Heart muscle, spinal cord and conditionally focal brain injury, in-place nephron restoration, and grown replacement organs are treated as distinct capabilities. A single master regeneration program and a standalone adult limb entry were not added.

original_dispositions.original_title: Non-addictive, highly effective, mechanism-specific chronic pain therapy
original_dispositions.reason: Suzetrigine’s approval is for acute postoperative analgesia. The chronic, selective capability remains missing.

original_dispositions.original_title: Perfect multi-cancer early detection blood test with greater than 95% sensitivity and specificity for stage I disease
original_dispositions.reason: Added in narrowed form as screening that changes late presentation and mortality for cancers without an existing effective screen. The historical 95% figures are not used.

original_dispositions.original_title: Safe, systemic, one-time in vivo gene editing for any monogenic or complex genetic disease
original_dispositions.reason: The retained bar is disease-changing in-body correction beyond the liver, including unconditioned blood stem cells. The historical demands of 100% efficiency, no off-target edits, no immune response, and applicability to any complex disease are not adopted.

original_dispositions.original_title: Complete reversal of advanced autoimmune diseases without broad immunosuppression
original_dispositions.reason: Drug-free remission after CD19 CAR T-cell therapy in refractory lupus is recorded as lineage depletion in small series, not programmable antigen-specific tolerance.

original_dispositions.original_title: Fully functional bioartificial or bioengineered organs grown on demand
original_dispositions.reason: This is distinct from porcine xenotransplantation and native-heart repair. The proposed completion is years of essential organ function after implantation, without adopting every historical specification.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal, safe platform for inducing immune tolerance to any antigen
original_dispositions.reason: The historical item and the first-pass concept are the same capability and were not given separate IDs.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CLM-01 through CLM-10 are retained with the same identities and the same completion bars. Wording was tightened where a new source changed the state of the evidence. No first-pass concept was deleted, replaced, or merged away.
Current state amended with the opened Riella PubMed abstract and company communications on expanded access, EXPAND, and clearance of a planned eGenesis study.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The abstract confirms 271 days of dialysis independence and subsequent events; the communications do not establish multi-year destination therapy.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Reservoir-clearance completion retained; hepatitis B functional cure recorded as a partial result, and bepirovirsen licensure not asserted.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Functional cure is broader and weaker than clearance because immune control can leave virus present.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CLM-03 remains limited to symptomatic Alzheimer’s disease. CLM-09 does not adopt 100% whole-body editing or extend to arbitrary polygenic disease.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The broader historical formulations are not retained as demonstrated single capabilities.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CLM-11 added for a human organ assembled outside the body.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: It is a different supply route from a xenograft and from in-place remuscularization. Lo and colleagues show filtration in preclinical settings, not the clinical capability.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CLM-12 added after reconsideration of the first-pass rejection of next-generation analgesics.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Suzetrigine establishes a new acute non-opioid class; selective, durable control of pathological chronic pain remains unachieved.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CLM-13 added after reconsideration of the first-pass rejection of multi-cancer early detection. The historical greater-than-95% stage I sensitivity and specificity figures are not used.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The unachieved capability is population-level reduction of late presentation and death for cancers without a screening program; NHS-Galleri did not reduce stage III or IV cancer.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CLM-14 added for a universal, shelf-stable oxygen carrier.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: A radical change in access can qualify where donor red cells already treat hemorrhage when available. The opened Shock abstract supports non-approval and excess adverse events for hemoglobin-based carriers.

reconciliation_change_log.change: CLM-15 added for in-place restoration of adult nephron number. Adult limb regeneration was not given an ID.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Nephron restoration is distinct from a xenograft, built organ, heart repair, and cord repair. The key supporting sentence is indexed text after direct page opening failed; a single master regeneration program would duplicate distinct entries.
